The letter P is centred and fills about 70% of the image height, its shape clearly readable; the rest of the sheet is plain empty ground. Antique archival look, fine detail, even soft shadowless lighting, seen straight from above. No other letters, no words, no numbers, no labels, no captions, no watermark, no frame, no border.
